subtitle: HSK 3 · Lesson 3 — 桌子上放着很多饮料 · There are plenty of drinks on the table

data.topic: 课文1 · 1. 在小丽家 — At Xiaoli's home

items.py: háishi
items.en: or

items.py: pá shān
items.en: to climb a mountain

items.py: xiǎoxīn
items.en: careful

items.zh: 小刚：明天是晴天还是阴天？
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Míngtiān shì qíngtiān háishi yīntiān?
items.en: Xiaogang: Will it be sunny or cloudy tomorrow?

items.zh: 小丽：阴天，电视上说多云。怎么了？有事？
items.py: Xiǎolì: Yīntiān, diànshì shang shuō duōyún. Zěnme le? Yǒu shì?
items.en: Xiaoli: Cloudy. The TV says it'll be overcast. Why? Something up?

items.zh: 小刚：没事，我们明天要去爬山。
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Méi shì, wǒmen míngtiān yào qù pá shān.
items.en: Xiaogang: Nothing much, we're going mountain climbing tomorrow.

items.zh: 小丽：爬山的时候要小心点儿。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Pá shān de shíhou yào xiǎoxīn diǎnr.
items.en: Xiaoli: Be a bit careful when you're climbing.

items.py: Xiǎogāng: Hǎo, nǐ yě qù ma?
items.en: Xiaogang: OK. Are you coming too?

items.py: Xiǎolì: Wǒ bù qù, wǒ yǒu shì.
items.en: Xiaoli: No, I have something to do.

items.py: chènshān

items.zh: 周太太：你觉得这条裤子怎么样？
items.py: Zhōu tàitai: Nǐ juéde zhè tiáo kùzi zěnmeyàng?
items.en: Mrs. Zhou: What do you think of these pants?

items.zh: 周明：我记得你已经有两条这样的裤子了。
items.py: Zhōu Míng: Wǒ jìde nǐ yǐjīng yǒu liǎng tiáo zhèyàng de kùzi le.
items.en: Zhou Ming: I remember you already have two pairs of pants like these.

items.zh: 周太太：那我们再看看别的。
items.py: Zhōu tàitai: Nà wǒmen zài kànkan biéde.
items.en: Mrs. Zhou: Then let's look at something else.

items.py: Zhōu Míng: Zhè jiàn chènshān zěnmeyàng?
items.en: Zhou Ming: How about this shirt?

items.py: Zhōu tàitai: Hái bùcuò, duōshao qián?
items.en: Mrs. Zhou: Not bad. How much is it?

items.py: Zhōu Míng: Zhè shàngmian xiězhe sān bǎi èrshí yuán.
items.en: Zhou Ming: It says 320 yuan on it.

items.py: Zhōu tàitai: Mǎi yī jiàn.
items.en: Mrs. Zhou: Let's buy one.

data.topic: 课文3 · 3. 在水果店 — In a fruit store

items.py: xīnxiān
items.en: fresh

items.py: tián
items.en: sweet

items.py: zhǐ
items.en: only, solely

items.zh: 周太太：这些水果真新鲜，我们买西瓜还是苹果？
items.py: Zhōu tàitai: Zhèxiē shuǐguǒ zhēn xīnxiān, wǒmen mǎi xīguā háishi píngguǒ?
items.en: Mrs. Zhou: This fruit is really fresh. Shall we buy a watermelon or apples?

items.zh: 周明：西瓜吧。你看，这上面写着“西瓜不甜不要钱”。
items.py: Zhōu Míng: Xīguā ba. Nǐ kàn, zhè shàngmian xiězhe “xīguā bù tián bù yào qián”.
items.en: Zhou Ming: A watermelon. Look, it says here: "If the watermelon isn't sweet, it's free."

items.zh: 周太太：那我们买一个大点儿的吧。
items.py: Zhōu tàitai: Nà wǒmen mǎi yī ge dà diǎnr de ba.
items.en: Mrs. Zhou: Then let's buy a bigger one.

items.py: Zhōu Míng: Zài mǎi jǐ ge píngguǒ.
items.en: Zhou Ming: And a few apples too.

items.zh: 周太太：好啊，今天晚上只吃水果不吃饭！
items.py: Zhōu tàitai: Hǎo a, jīntiān wǎnshang zhǐ chī shuǐguǒ bù chī fàn!
items.en: Mrs. Zhou: Great, tonight we'll eat only fruit and no dinner!

items.zh: 小丽：桌子上放着很多饮料，你喝什么？
items.py: Xiǎolì: Zhuōzi shang fàngzhe hěn duō yǐnliào, nǐ hē shénme?
items.en: Xiaoli: There are lots of drinks on the table. What will you have?

items.zh: 小刚：茶或者咖啡都可以。你呢？你喝什么？
items.py: Xiǎogāng: Chá huòzhě kāfēi dōu kěyǐ. Nǐ ne? Nǐ hē shénme?
items.en: Xiaogang: Tea or coffee, either is fine. And you? What will you drink?

items.zh: 小丽：我喝茶，茶是我的最爱。天冷了或者工作累了的时候，喝杯热茶会很舒服。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Wǒ hē chá, chá shì wǒ de zuì ài. Tiān lěng le huòzhě gōngzuò lèi le de shíhou, hē bēi rè chá huì hěn shūfu.
items.en: Xiaoli: I'll have tea; tea is my favourite. When it's cold or I'm tired from work, a cup of hot tea feels really good.

items.py: Xiǎogāng: Nǐ xǐhuan hē shénme chá?
items.en: Xiaogang: What kind of tea do you like?

items.zh: 小丽：花茶、绿茶、红茶，我都喜欢。
items.py: Xiǎolì: Huāchá, lǜchá, hóngchá, wǒ dōu xǐhuan.
items.en: Xiaoli: Flower tea, green tea, black tea: I like them all.

items.py: Nǐ yào hē kāfēi háishi hē chá?
items.en: Do you want coffee or tea?

items.py: Míngtiān shì qíngtiān háishi yīntiān?
items.en: Will it be sunny or cloudy tomorrow?

items.zh: 今天晚上吃米饭或者面条都可以。
items.py: Jīntiān wǎnshang chī mǐfàn huòzhě miàntiáo dōu kěyǐ.
items.en: Tonight either rice or noodles is fine.

items.zh: 天冷了或者工作累了的时候，喝杯热茶很舒服。
items.py: Tiān lěng le huòzhě gōngzuò lèi le de shíhou, hē bēi rè chá hěn shūfu.
items.en: When it's cold or you're tired from work, a cup of hot tea is very comforting.

items.zh: 周太太40岁还是50岁，我们不知道。
items.py: Zhōu tàitai sìshí suì háishi wǔshí suì, wǒmen bù zhīdào.
items.en: We don't know whether Mrs. Zhou is 40 or 50.

items.zh: 小丽还没想好周末去爬山还是去看电影。
items.py: Xiǎolì hái méi xiǎnghǎo zhōumò qù pá shān háishi qù kàn diànyǐng.
items.en: Xiaoli hasn't decided yet whether to go climbing or to see a movie this weekend.

items.zh: 他的生日是10月还是11月，我不记得了。
items.py: Tā de shēngrì shì shí yuè háishi shíyī yuè, wǒ bù jìde le.
items.en: I don't remember whether his birthday is in October or November.

items.zh: 我不知道这个人是男的还是女的。
items.py: Wǒ bù zhīdào zhège rén shì nán de háishi nǚ de.
items.en: I don't know whether this person is a man or a woman.

data.topic: 语法 · Grammar (存在：处所 + V着 + 数量 + N)

items.py: Zhuōzi shang fàngzhe yī bēi kāfēi.
items.en: There's a cup of coffee on the table.

items.zh: 我家楼上住着一个老师。
items.py: Wǒ jiā lóu shàng zhùzhe yī ge lǎoshī.
items.en: A teacher lives upstairs from us.

items.py: Shàngmian xiězhe sān bǎi èrshí yuán.
items.en: It says 320 yuan on it.

items.py: Zhuōzi shang fàngzhe hěn duō yǐnliào.
items.en: There are lots of drinks on the table.

items.py: Zhuōzi shang méi fàngzhe kāfēi.
items.en: There's no coffee on the table.

items.py: Wǒ jiā lóu shàng méi zhùzhe lǎoshī.
items.en: No teacher lives upstairs from us.

items.py: Shàngmian méi xiězhe duōshao qián.
items.en: It doesn't say how much it costs.

items.py: Zhuōzi shang méi fàngzhe yǐnliào.
items.en: There are no drinks on the table.

items.zh: 你穿得那么少，会感冒的。
items.py: Nǐ chuān de nàme shǎo, huì gǎnmào de.
items.en: You're wearing so little, you'll catch a cold.

items.zh: 别担心，我会照顾好自己。
items.py: Bié dānxīn, wǒ huì zhàogù hǎo zìjǐ.
items.en: Don't worry, I'll take good care of myself.

items.zh: 你不给他打电话吗，他会不高兴的。
items.py: Nǐ bù gěi tā dǎ diànhuà ma, tā huì bù gāoxìng de.
items.en: Aren't you going to call him? He'll be unhappy.

items.py: Hē bēi rè chá huì hěn shūfu.
items.en: A cup of hot tea will feel really good.
